subject: POC kickoff — hands-on session logistics, site access, and load validation plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fincrest.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincrest.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session logistics, site access, and load validation plan

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the outline. Quick question as we lock in the kickoff: our engineering leadership prefers an on-site kickstart for the hands-on routing/load tests so they can observe latency characteristics live. That said, some folks will be remote.

Two quick asks:
- Can we confirm room requirements (A/V + separate table for two engineers to run local clients)?
- What is your preference on recording the session? We might want a short recording for our internal notes, but we also have strict vendor recording policy — we need to get consent forms in advance.

I'm attaching our site access policy — it includes names and IDs for the attendees.

Liam
(Lead Platform Engineer, FinCrest)

Attachment: fincrest_site_access_policy.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fincrest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincrest.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session logistics, site access, and load validation plan

Hi Liam / Priya —

Appreciate the heads up. On our side we can support an on-site kickoff with hybrid streaming for remote participants. Clarifying details below so we can lock the calendar and facilities: 

1) Room & A/V
- We recommend a conference room with projector + HDMI and a dedicated table for 2 engineers to run clients (we'll bring a small switch and power strip).
- Can you confirm whether FinCrest can provide a wired drop to the table or if we should rely on our hotspot? Wired is strongly preferred for consistent load measurements.

2) Recording & Permissions
- Redwood policy: we can record the screen share and system metrics streams but will not record video of FinCrest attendees unless you sign consent. We can disable recording on request.

3) Visitor Access
- Please send the final attendee list with government ID numbers by EOD Mon so the front desk can issue badges. We'll also send a short visitor guidance doc (parking, Wi-Fi, NDA reminders).

4) Load test plan and timing
- Attached is our proposed load-test plan (light/medium/stress phases). Suggest we reserve 90 minutes for the hands-on portion: 30m prompt review & routing, 45m load validation, 15m quick retrospective.

Can you confirm onsite vs fully virtual preference by EOD today? If onsite, we will send the visitor_instructions.docx and the consent template.

Thanks —
Tessa
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_agenda_v3.pdf, load-test-plan.xlsx
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincrest.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fincrest.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session logistics, site access, and load validation plan

Tessa —

Thanks for the detail. We are leaning toward onsite for the first day so leadership and platform teams can be hands-on. A couple of notes from our side: 

- We can provide a wired drop to the table but need your team to bring a short patch cable (our racks are in a locked room).
- Recording: leadership prefers we record the screen share only. We'll sign the consent for screen capture but not video.
- Visitor IDs: attaching the list with badge names. Please confirm front-desk will have temporary badges ready.

Proposed time slot: Tue Sep 22, 09:30–12:00 ET. Can you confirm Redwood resources (Marissa & Dylan) are available?

Priya
(Technical Program Manager, FinCrest)

Attachment: fincrest_attendee_list_ids.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincrest.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session logistics, site access, and load validation plan

Priya / Tessa —

We can confirm availability for Tue Sep 22, 09:30–12:00 ET. A few operational notes from our side:

- We'll bring a dedicated laptop for local client runs and an inline network tap (for monitoring). We'll also bring a 5m Cat6 patch cable; if you can provide a short patch to the rack, that's perfect.
- For recording: Redwood will only record the screen share (system telemetry + prompt session). We'll provide the consent form PDF for your legal team to sign.
- Please confirm whether gallery view or speaker view is acceptable for the remote attendees — gallery helps Q&A but uses more bandwidth.

Action items:
- FinCrest: confirm front desk will issue badges for the attached attendee list (Priya)
- FinCrest: reply with onsite contact for escorting Redwood team to the rack room (name + phone)
- Redwood (Marissa): I will book the internal resources and create the calendar invite once front-desk confirmation comes through.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fincrest.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session logistics, site access, and load validation plan

All —

Thanks for the confirmations. Quick status update and next steps: 

- Calendar: I created the Google Calendar event (link below) for Tue Sep 22, 09:30–12:00 ET and invited everyone. Please accept so we can finalize catering.
- Visitor badges: Priya confirmed front-desk will have temporary badges; Marissa, please share final attendee list with Priya by EOD Mon.
- Recording consent: attaching the screen-capture consent template. Priya, please route to legal and let us know if any changes are required.
- Load-test checklist: Dylan, can you prepare the monitoring dashboard links and a short runbook (5 bullet steps) for the stress phase? We'd like those pinned in the doc before we start.

Attachments: visitor_instructions.docx, consent_screen_capture.pdf

See you all on the 22nd —
Tessa
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
